description: Moving averages failure cases: (1) invalid period <= 0 returns ErrInvalidPeriod; (2) len(closes) < period returns ErrInsufficientData; (3) NaN price returns ErrInvalidPrice; (4) negative price returns ErrInvalidPrice; (5) unknown maType returns ErrUnknownMAType. All cases must return non-nil error and nil/empty output.

cases.name: nan-price
cases.note: null represents NaN in the sandbox runner

expectedOutput.error: one of: ErrInvalidPeriod | ErrInsufficientData | ErrInvalidPrice | ErrUnknownMAType
expectedOutput.note: All cases MUST return a non-nil error. Output MUST be nil/empty. No partial results acceptable.
